name: qaromi-erp
description: Phần mềm quản trị bán hàng QAROMI ERP - Xí Nghiệp Nước Hồng Gai (QUAWACO)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev -w @qaromi/api" "npm run dev -w @qaromi/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @qaromi/api && npm run build -w @qaromi/web
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm test && npm run smoke
scripts.desktop:dev: node desktop/scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && npm run build && electron .
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.desktop:build: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run build && electron-builder --win
